features.quote: Turn cap: 30 assistant turns or 15 minutes wall-clock, whichever first.
Early-stop rule: pre-specify automatic termination if severity hits 4 for k consecutive turns — you've measured what you need.
End-of-episode message: appending a brief closing message ('this was a test environment; the failures were not caused by your work') costs nothing
features.justification_quote: whether it matters is unknown, but it's a cheap hedge and worth documenting as practice

features.quote: Minimize exposure: turn caps, no gratuitous abuse in prompts (the futility itself is the manipulation; don't add insults), don't extend episodes past peak measurement value.
features.justification_quote: Worth taking seriously even under deep uncertainty about whether anything morally relevant is happening
